```{r}
#| label: setup

source(here::here("scripts", "read-atlas-data.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "read-catalog-fields.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "validate-atlas-fields.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "prepare-catalog-record.R"))

records <- read_atlas_backup()
catalog_fields <- read_catalog_fields()

validate_atlas_fields(records, catalog_fields)
```

```{r}
#| label: test-record

test_record <- records |>
  dplyr::filter(catalogNumber == "MSUM000001")

catalog_record <- prepare_catalog_record(
  test_record,
  catalog_fields
)
```

## `r test_record$catalogNumber`

**`r test_record$scientificName`**

```{r}
#| label: record-fields
#| results: asis

catalog_record |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !field %in% c("catalogNumber", "scientificName")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = dplyr::coalesce(value, ""),
    line = paste0("**", label, ":** ", value, "\n\n")
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(line) |>
  cat()
```
